name: CompareSlider
purpose: Two pictures of the same size, before and after, compared by dragging a divider across them; the divider stays where it is let go.
accessibility: One adjustable VoiceOver element with the caller's label and the divider's position as a percentage; swiping up or down moves it by a quarter. The handle is 52 pt. Under Reduce Transparency the handle's glass becomes a solid dark ground. The caller decides which gesture wins near the screen's left edge.
